name: Imouto Ijime
source:
I have a little sister...
She's cute. She's my cute little sister Rin. 
Our parents got married and we became a family.
However... Recently I started to feel strange.
Now I feel lust for Rin.
I just see your body or touch it and I got a hard on...
Haaa... Rin... You're so cute Rin...
I think I've reached my limit... 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=672939&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
我有一个小妹妹…
她很可爱。她是我可爱的妹妹凛。
我们的父母结婚了，我们成了一家人。
然而……最近我开始感觉奇怪了。
现在我对凛产生了欲望。
我只是看到你的身体或触摸它，我就感到很兴奋……
哈啊……凛……你好可爱啊凛……
我想我已经达到了我的极限…
